newsitem.title: USA: Opponent questions NY mayor's ties to News Corp.
newsitem.headline: Opponent questions NY mayor's ties to News Corp.

text.p: A political rival of New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani said on Tuesday the mayor's efforts to win channel space for News Corp Ltd's all-news television service should be investigated by a government ethics panel.

Manhattan Borough President Ruth Messinger, a Democrat likely to oppose Republican Giuliani for re-election, said Giuliani's siding with News Corp and its chairman Rupert Murdoch was a conflict of interest since the mayor's wife works for a local television station owned by News Corp.
Messinger formally requested the city's Conflicts of Interest Board to investigate.
"There is no conflict of interest," Giuliani said. "To try and attack my wife is a cheap shot."

Giuliani, whose wife Donna Hanover Giuliani is a local television personality, is backing News Corp's efforts to use a city cable-television channel as a New York outlet for its the Fox News Channel launched on Monday.
Cable-operator Time Warner Inc has already refused to carry Fox News on its local systems and opposes the mayor's proposal to lease a city channel to News Corp.
